[[Category: Presbyterian Ministers]]
[[Category: Westminster Cemetery, Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania]]
== Biography ==

Graduated Geneva College and Allegheny Seminary. Installed Pastor of Baltimore Reformed Presbyterian Congregation, 1885. 

Melanchthon was the author of <i>History of the Reformed Presbyterian Church in America</I>, 1888 [https://catalog.hathitrust.org/Record/008608020][https://books.google.com/books/about/History_of_the_Reformed_Presbyterian_Chu.html?id=FiJNAAAAYAAJ]. He also wrote a short [https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf History of the Glasgow family].
